name: A request exceeding the remaining balance is blocked with a clear message

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and log in with email 'flow.attach@leave-portal.test' and password 'password' using the 'Log in' button.
Select 'Annual Leave' as leave type, set Start date to 2026-11-01 and End date to 2026-11-13 (13 days), and enter reason 'E2E overlimit marker'.
The submission is blocked with an inline validation error mentioning only 12 day(s) remain in the Annual Leave balance, and no request is created.
